code-py-v1-test.criterion: Descriptive; no pass/fail on the data. The build is accepted when the manifest's disjointness checks (13-gram overlap < 0.30 for every kept doc, no family link to train/val at est. Jaccard >= 0.4, no exact copies) are re-verified by --verify.
